answer: Pay a head the full per-head unit only once it holds an admission slot: each close admits a handful of the fifteen hundred identities waiting, from one global queue. Every head enters through the same inlet, and a slot requested now returns only an echo when the queue reaches it, so a farm's tenth head waits for nine of its own kind to clear first, and loses one full-minus-damped unit for every close it waits. Slots cannot be partitioned, bought or pre-aged, so n heads pay about n squared closes of delay and the marginal loss rises with the farm. The juniper rail publishes the queue.
